_doc: Clips and video by parts with the owner's «¿A quién le habla este video?» (m-25026509). Each case is the form the Clip flow submits (`CreativeState._generator_form`): the owner's sentence as the topic, a catalog product, its «Precio» key fact as the screen pre-fills it, kind clip with the app's default clip media (5 s, audio on, one product photo as reference, motion mode). Brands reuse the anonymised eval data: «hamburguesas» and «inmobiliaria» are the kits of ../copy_ai/cases.json (perks as in ../copy_ai/cases_niveles.json); «viajes» is the travel agency of ../reels_ai/cases.json, its kit written from that bio and flagged. Sentences are written for this eval in the owner's register. `leftover` cases put a price INSIDE the sentence on purpose: the known leftover of m-25026509 (only key facts, must-mention and price_line are stripped for unaware).
